title_hint: Heroku's Next Chapter
excerpt_hint: We will begin to sunset our free product plans for Heroku Dynos, Heroku Postgres and Heroku Data for Redis. We will start shutting down free dynos and data services on November 28, 2022.

title_hint: Sunsetting Atom
excerpt_hint: We are archiving Atom and all projects under the Atom organization for an official sunset on December 15, 2022.

title_hint: A message about Stadia and our long term streaming strategy
excerpt_hint: We have made the difficult decision to begin winding down our Stadia streaming service.

title_hint: Google Cloud Platform Services Summary
excerpt_hint: IoT Core will be discontinued on August 16, 2023 and is not accepting new customers.

title_hint: We apologize. We did a terrible job announcing the end of Docker Free Teams.
excerpt_hint: Free Team subscriptions were deprecated and users would lose features unless they moved to supported free or paid offerings.

title_hint: HashiCorp adopts Business Source License
excerpt_hint: HashiCorp has adopted the Business Source License for future releases of HashiCorp products, changing the license terms for future releases.

title_hint: Unity pricing updates
excerpt_hint: We are introducing a new Unity Runtime Fee and pricing changes based on game installs and revenue thresholds.

title_hint: Creating a Healthy Ecosystem for Reddit Data and Reddit Data API Access
excerpt_hint: We are sharing updates to Reddit Data API access and introducing changes to how third parties access Reddit data, including commercial access terms.

title_hint: Updates to IFTTT free tier
excerpt_hint: Starting on May 23, all free users will be limited to 2 Applets and unable to use Twitter Applets. Additional Applets outside the tier will be deactivated.

title_hint: Updates to Twitter access
excerpt_hint: Starting on May 23, Twitter access will no longer be available to our free plan users. To continue using Twitter on IFTTT you will need a Pro or Pro+ subscription.

title_hint: The transition of Chrome extensions to Manifest V3
excerpt_hint: We are sharing details about the plan to phase out Manifest V2 extensions. The Chrome browser will no longer run Manifest V2 extensions after the transition.

title_hint: The next phase of digital whiteboarding for Google Workspace
excerpt_hint: In late 2024, we will wind down the Jamboard whiteboarding app and continue with the planned end of support for Google Jamboard devices.

title_hint: Google Podcasts is going away
excerpt_hint: In 2024, Google Podcasts will be discontinued and users will be able to migrate podcast subscriptions to YouTube Music.

title_hint: End of Life (EOL) for Twilio Authy Desktop app
excerpt_hint: The Authy Desktop app for Linux, macOS and Windows will reach End-of-Life on March 19, 2024 and will no longer be supported.

title_hint: Investing in what moves the internet forward
excerpt_hint: We have made the difficult decision to phase out Pocket and Fakespot. Pocket shuts down July 8, 2025.

title_hint: Saying goodbye to Carousel and Mailbox
excerpt_hint: We have made the difficult decision to shut down Carousel and Mailbox. Mailbox will be shut down on February 26, 2016 and Carousel on March 31, 2016.

product: IFTTT SMS and Phone Call free access
title_hint: Important Changes to the SMS, Phone Call, and Email Services
excerpt_hint: Beginning in February 2023 the SMS and Phone Call services will only be available to Pro, Pro+, and Legacy Pro users. Free Tier Applets using these services will be disconnected.

title_hint: A message to our community: Unity is canceling the Runtime Fee
excerpt_hint: We have made the decision to cancel the Runtime Fee for our games customers, effective immediately.
notes: A reversal event included deliberately so the benchmark can exercise future retraction handling.

title_hint: Introducing GitHub Skills
excerpt_hint: Today we are announcing GitHub Skills, a new learning experience to help developers learn GitHub.

title_hint: Introducing Achievements: recognizing the many stages of a developer's coding journey
excerpt_hint: We are announcing Achievements as a new way to commemorate milestones on GitHub.

title_hint: Go Pro (for free)
excerpt_hint: Our Free plan includes a limited number of Applets and Pro users can create more Applets and use advanced features.

title_hint: Introducing WebAuthn support for secure Dropbox sign in
excerpt_hint: We are using WebAuthn to make it easier to add an extra level of security to Dropbox accounts.

title_hint: What's new in Chrome extensions
excerpt_hint: This update introduces new extension platform capabilities and documentation improvements.

title_hint: HashiCorp updates licensing FAQ based on community questions
excerpt_hint: HashiCorp continues to update its licensing FAQ based on questions from the community about the previously announced change.
